elements_selected.content: Wire section grounding hashes from scan-time into the theory cache per REQ-041c. During zetl index (or the combined index+reason pipeline): after computing Merkle leaves and sections, populate SplLeafCached with section_index (which section the SPL leaf belongs to) and the section's grounding_hash. In the theory cache (theory.json v2), the spl_blocks map entry for each SPL block must include: section_heading (string), section_grounding_hash (hex). When the theory is built (reason engine), copy these values from the scan results into TheoryCache::spl_blocks. Implement the theory cache population in src/reason/mod.rs (or reason engine) by reading the FileMerkle data stored alongside the parsed SPL blocks. Ensure section grounding is computed for standalone .spl files too — since they have no Markdown sections, their grounding is empty (no section, no grounding hash). Section grounding does NOT apply to standalone .spl files per §4.7.
